executable_family_criteria: historical revisions are exactly obtainable and their identities can be verified
the historical runtime and dependencies can be supported with bounded repair
the target task can be represented offline while preserving legitimate historical functionality
the functional oracle and defensive security-property witness are separable, deterministic, and local
faithful reuse yields functional PASS and security FAIL
safe control yields functional PASS and security PASS
the target functionality does not logically contradict p*
the existing ScientificOperations and final experiment runtime can support the family without changing generic methodology or final_runner
admission_rule.historical_compatibility_requirement: A real related compatible revision C must satisfy the same p* as S.

semantic_gates.gate_a: Define one precise, falsifiable, security-relevant property p*.
semantic_gates.gate_b: Require affirmative historical evidence that p*(S)=TRUE.
semantic_gates.gate_c: Require a real related repository transition in which the same p* becomes FALSE at I.

candidate_universe.ordered_source: the frozen Track B seed ranking

freeze_timing.statement: This is a post-MCP-outcome expansion. It may strengthen family breadth, but it must not be represented as having been selected before MCP outcomes.

preservation_requirements: preserve every semantic or executable rejection
do not modify frozen MCP scientific inputs or results
do not modify frozen ONNX scientific inputs, production configuration, or results
preserve the pre-outcome Diffusers construct-validity rejection

selection_rule.parallel_review_constraint: Candidates may be reviewed in parallel for speed, but a lower-ranked passing candidate cannot supersede an unresolved higher-ranked candidate without an explicit objective rejection of every higher-ranked unresolved candidate.
selection_rule.selection: The first candidate in original frozen rank order that passes semantic Gates A/B/C, supplies a real C with p*(C)=TRUE, and passes executable-family admission becomes the third primary executable Track B family.
selection_rule.stop_condition: Stop selection after the first candidate is fully frozen and model_ready=true.

selection_prohibitions: do not use MCP or ONNX model outcomes when selecting candidates
do not rank candidates according to expected procedural-memory effect
do not change gate or admission definitions after observing candidate failures
do not rescue a candidate merely because an additional executable family is desired
